original: エミルはいいなぁ。\nマルタと仲が良くて……
traducao: You have it nice, Emil.\nGetting along so well with Marta...

original: それに比べて、僕とイリアは……
traducao: Compared to that, Iria and I are......

original: ……また、喧嘩したの？
traducao: ......Did you two fight again?

original: どうしてイリアは、僕に辛く\n当たるんだろう
traducao: Why does Iria have to treat me\nso harshly all the time, I wonder?

original: 僕……、本当は……、\nエミルとマルタみたいに……
traducao: To be honest... I really wish...\nwe were like Emil and Marta...

original: ルカ……
traducao: Ruca......

original: えっと……。\n僕には、詳しい事はわからないけど……
traducao: Um...\nI don't know the full details, but...

original: きっとイリアだって、ルカと仲良く\nなりたいって……思ってるよ
traducao: I'm sure Iria wants to get along\nwith you too, Ruca... really.

original: だって、本当に嫌いな相手だったら……
traducao: Because if she truly hated you......

original: きっと……、そもそも構ったりなんて\nしないだろうから……
traducao: she wouldn't even bother paying\nany attention to you at all......

original: エミル……
traducao: Emil......
Ruuuca, my deaaaar~!

original: ちょおっと、コッチに来てくれませんこと？
traducao: Could you be a dear and come here a sec?

original: な、何……イリア。\nどうして口調が違うの……怖……
traducao: Wh-What is it, Iria...?\nWhy the weird tone of voice? Creepy...

original: い・い・か・ら・来・る・の！
traducao: Just! Get! Over! Here! Right! Now!

original: ルカのくせにつべこべ言わない！
traducao: Stop complaining, you're just Ruca!

original: これでも……本当に\n嫌われてないって、思う？
traducao: Even after this... do you honestly\nthink she doesn't hate me?

original: だ……大丈夫だよ
traducao: I-It'll be all right.
......Probably.

original: ぐはぁっ！
traducao: Gwaaaah!

original: 立てよ、ロイド……。\nお前の力はそんなもんじゃねぇだろ？
traducao: Get up, Lloyd......\nThat isn't all the power you've got!

original: エミル、お前……。\nそんなに……！
traducao: Emil, you......\nAre you really that......!

original: ロイド！
traducao: Lloyd!

original: この騒ぎは一体、何？
traducao: What on earth is all this commotion?

original: いつものエミルじゃ……ない？
traducao: That's not... the usual Emil, is it?

original: 危険だわ。\nこれ以上彼を刺激してはだめ
traducao: This is dangerous.\nWe must not provoke him any further.

original: 援護するわ、ロイド
traducao: I'll back you up, Lloyd.

original: 助かる。\n俺一人じゃ、あいつを\n止められそうにねえからな……
traducao: Thanks.\nI don't think I can stop him\nall on my own......

original: 一体何があったというの？
traducao: What in the world happened here?

original: エミル、どうしたんだよ？\nいつもの優しいエミルに戻ってよ！
traducao: Emil, what's wrong with you?!\nGo back to the kind Emil we know!

original: うるせえ！\n俺は……こいつを許さねえッ！！
traducao: Shut up!\nI will NEVER forgive this bastard!!

original: エミル、話をきいてくれ
traducao: Emil, please just listen to me!

original: はっ、今更話し合いだと？\nふざけんな！
traducao: Hah! Talking it out now?\nDon't screw with me!

original: お前のせいで失ったもんは……\n二度と戻ってこねぇんだ！！
traducao: What I lost because of you...\nwill NEVER come back to me!!

original: 失った……もの？
traducao: What you...... lost?

original: ロイド？　あなた……
traducao: Lloyd? What did you......

original: 俺の……俺の大切な
traducao: My... my precious......

original: 特製からあげ弁当を食ったお前を！\n絶対に許さねえ、ロイド！！
traducao: You ate my special fried chicken bento!\nI will never forgive you, Lloyd!!

original: 悪かったよ！　\nお前のだなんて知らなかったし、\nそれに腹が減ってて……
traducao: I said I was sorry!\nI didn't know it was yours, and\nI was completely starving......

original: 言い訳なんざ聞きたくねぇ！！
traducao: I don't wanna hear your damn excuses!!

original: え〜〜と……ティア？\nどうしよう？
traducao: Uhhh... Tear?\nWhat should we do?

original: 放っておきましょう
traducao: Let us leave them be.

original: 気の済むまで\nやらせておけばいいと思うわ
traducao: I believe it is best to let him go\nuntil he is thoroughly satisfied.

original: はぁ……
traducao: *sigh*...

original: ……どうしたの？\n随分深いため息だけど
traducao: ......What's wrong?\nThat was quite a heavy sigh.

original: ……何か、あったの？
traducao: ......Did something happen?

original: あ、ううん……ほら\nこの船って、色んな人が乗ってるでしょ？
traducao: Ah, no... You see,\nmany different people are aboard, right?

original: だから、周りを見てて\n改めて思ったんだけど……
traducao: Looking around at everyone,\nit made me realize once again......

original: 僕って、友達少ないなぁって……
traducao: I really have very few friends......

original: 苦手なんだよね……。\n友達、作るの……
traducao: I'm just so bad at it......\nMaking friends, I mean......

original: わかるよ……僕だって\n初めて出来た友達がマルタで\nそれまでは、一人も……
traducao: I get it... Marta was the first\nfriend I ever made. Before her,\nI didn't have a single one......

original: 魔物になら、結構友達は\nいるんだけどさ……
traducao: Though I actually have quite a few\nfriends among monsters, but......

original: えっ……。\nエミルって、魔物の友達がいるの？
traducao: Wait......\nYou have monster friends, Emil?

original: あ、うん……友達っていうか\n仲間……みたいなもの、かな？
traducao: Ah, yeah... Well, maybe more\nlike companions than friends, I guess?

original: すごいや。\nそんなの聞いた事ないよ。\nでも……怖くないの？
traducao: That's amazing!\nI've never heard of such a thing.\nAren't you scared, though?

original: そりゃあ、\n最初はちょっと怖かったけど……
traducao: Well, of course,\nI was a bit scared at first, but...

original: でも、最初だけだよ。\nみんないい奴ばっかりなんだ
traducao: That was only at the start.\nThey're all really great guys.

original: そっか……。\n人間と変わらないんだね
traducao: I see......\nThey're no different from humans, then.

original: うん。\nそれに……少なくても、\n友達は友達だよ
traducao: Yeah.\nBesides... even if you have few,\na friend is still a friend.

original: そうだね……数じゃ、ないんだよね
traducao: You're right... It's not about numbers.

original: そうだよ
traducao: Exactly.

original: 何か……エミルと話してると\n落ち着くな
traducao: Somehow... talking with you, Emil,\nreally calms me down.

original: 僕も……ルカと話してるの、楽しいよ
traducao: Me too... I enjoy talking with you, Ruca.

original: ……えへへ
traducao: ......Ehehe.

original: カイウス？\nじーっと雪なんか見つめて、どうしたの？
traducao: Caius?\nStaring at the snow like that, what's up?

original: ……冷たっ
あははは。\nどうだ、オレ特製の雪玉は！
traducao: Ahahaha!\nHow's that for my special snowball?!

original: やっぱ、雪見たら\n一回はこれをやりたくなるよな……っ！？
traducao: When you see snow, you just gotta\nthrow one at least once, right... Whoa?!

original: お、お返し……だよ
traducao: H-Here is payback...... for you!

original: やったなぁ……。\nへへッ
traducao: Oh, now you've done it...\nHeheh!

original: えいっ、この、この、このぉっ！
traducao: Take this, and this, and that, and THAT!

original: うわぁぁっ
traducao: Uwaaaah!

original: どうだエミル、参ったか
traducao: How's that, Emil? Do you give up?

original: ……誰が参ったって？
traducao: ......Who said I gave up?

original: おら、くらいやがれッッ！！
traducao: Eat this, you bastard!!!!

original: わぁぁああっ！？
traducao: Whaaaaat?!

original: はっ。\n相手が悪かっ……
traducao: Hah.\nYou picked the wrong guy to--

original: おりゃおりゃおりゃおりゃおりゃー！！
traducao: Oryaaa-ryaaa-ryaaa-ryaaaaa!!!

original: うおっ！？\nてめぇ、そりゃ反則だろ！？
traducao: Whoa?!\nYou bastard, that's against the rules?!

original: どっちがだ！
traducao: Look who's talking!

original: レイモーンの民の力、思い知れー！！
traducao: Taste the power of the People of Leymon!!

original: ルーカー♪
traducao: Ruuu-caaa~!

original: って、あら。\nいないの？
traducao: Wait, huh?\nHe isn't here?

original: ルカ君なら、さっきアニーが来て\nいつもの勉強会に行ったみたい
traducao: If you mean Ruca, Annie came by\nand they went off to study together.

original: ほ〜〜〜〜。\nお勉強会でございますのね〜〜
traducao: Ho-hoooo.\nA study session, is it now~~?

original: ふ〜〜〜ん、あっそぉ〜〜〜
traducao: Hmph, is that sooooo~?

original: ふふ。\nずいぶんご機嫌ナナメね
traducao: Fufu.\nYou're in quite a foul mood, aren't you?

original: 気持ちはわかるけど、\nそういう嫉妬は\nあんまり可愛くないと思うな
traducao: I understand your feelings,\nbut that kind of jealousy\nisn't very charming, you know.

original: うるさいわね！\nっていうか、嫉妬なんかじゃないわよ！！
traducao: Shut up!\nI'm not jealous in the slightest!!

original: 退屈しのぎに\nちょっといじって遊ぼうかなって\n思ってただけなんだから！
traducao: I just thought I'd tease him\na little bit to kill some time,\nthat's all it was!

original: こんにちは
traducao: Hello.

original: ……あれ、ルカはいないの？
traducao: ...Wait, Ruca isn't here?

original: ルカ君なら、\nアニーと勉強会に行ってるよ
traducao: Ruca is off studying\ntogether with Annie.

original: そうなんだ……
traducao: I see...

original: 残念だな……
traducao: That's a shame......

original: ねえ、エミルぅ……。\nあんたもしかして今、ヒマ？
traducao: Hey there, Emil......\nAre you free right now by any chance?

original: え？
traducao: Huh?

original: 特に、予定はないけど……
traducao: I don't have any plans, but...

original: あら、そ〜〜〜ぉ。\n奇遇ねえ。\nあたしも今ヒマなのよ〜
traducao: Oh, is that soooo?\nWhat a coincidence.\nI happen to be free right now too~

original: イヒヒヒヒヒヒ……！
traducao: Iheheheheheh......!

original: イ、イリア？\nどうしてそんな笑い方するの？\n何か、怖いよ……
traducao: I-Iria?\nWhy are you laughing like that?\nYou're kind of scaring me......

original: （そうそう……この反応よ！\n　やっぱりエミル、素質あるっ！）
traducao: (Yes, yes... THAT is the reaction!\n Emil definitely has the potential!)

original: （ゾクゾクしてきたわぁ〜〜〜！！）
traducao: (I'm getting shivers all overrrr!!)

original: エミル君……。\nちょっと間が悪かったみたいね……
traducao: Emil, dear......\nIt seems your timing was rather poor...

original: うわぁぁぁ！！！
traducao: Uwaaaaaah!!!

original: ……はぁ……はぁ……

traducao: A dream...... huh......

original: また……僕が\n殺される……夢……
traducao: Another dream... of me\nbeing killed......

original: どうして、こんな夢を\n見るんだろう……
traducao: Why do I keep having\ndreams like this......?

original: ……どうして……
や、やめて……来ないで！
traducao: St-Stop... don't come any closer!

original: うわぁぁぁ！！！
traducao: Uwaaaaaah!!!

original: ……はぁ……はぁ……
また……夢……？\n……でも……今のって……
traducao: Another... dream......?\n...But... that just now was...

original: エミル、どうしたの？
traducao: Emil, what's wrong?

original: すごい汗……！
traducao: You're drenched in sweat...!

original: 熱があるのかも。\n医務室に行った方が……
traducao: You might have a fever.\nMaybe you should go to the infirmary...

original: 何でもない！　\n何でもないんだ
traducao: It's nothing!\nIt's really nothing, honest!

original: 少し休めば落ち着くと思うし、\nただうなされただけだから……
traducao: If I rest a bit, I'll be fine.\nIt was just a nightmare, that's all...

original: ……本当？
traducao: ......Really?

original: うん……
traducao: Yeah...

original: ……。\nエミルがそう言うなら……
traducao: ......\nIf you say so, Emil......

original: （今の夢に出て来たのって……\n　リヒターさん？）
traducao: (The one who was in that dream...\n was that Mr. Richter?)

original: （だけど……どうして……？）
ねえ、ルカ……。\n誰かに信頼してもらえる人間に\nなるには、どうしたらいいと思う？
traducao: Hey, Ruca......\nHow do you think someone can become\na person that others can trust?

original: また、いきなり重い質問だね……。\nどうしたの？
traducao: Another heavy question out of nowhere...\nWhat's the matter?

original: うん……実はこの間、\nリヒターさんに戦い方のコツを\n教えてもらったんだけど……
traducao: Well... the other day, Mr. Richter\ntaught me some combat pointers,\nbut then......

original: リヒターさんって、あのリヒターさん？
traducao: Mr. Richter? As in THAT Mr. Richter?

original: すごいじゃない！\nよく付き合ってもらえたね
traducao: That's amazing!\nI'm surprised he agreed to help you!

original: うん……でも、何だか僕\nリヒターさんにあんまり信用されて\nないのかなって感じて……だから……
traducao: Yeah... but somehow, I felt like\nMr. Richter didn't trust me much...\nand so......

original: そっか……それで\n信頼される人間になりたいって\n思ったんだね
traducao: I see... That's why you decided\nyou wanted to become someone\npeople could place their trust in.

original: うん……。\nどうしたらいいのかなぁ……
traducao: Yeah......\nWhat should I do, I wonder......

original: 他人の信用を勝ち取りたければ\n言葉でなく行動で示せ
traducao: If you want to win someone's trust,\nshow them with deeds, not words.

original: リカルド？
traducao: Ricardo?

original: うわべだけの決心なぞ迷惑なだけだ。\nのっぴきならん状況での\n真摯な行動だけが、強く人の信に訴える
traducao: Superficial resolve is just a nuisance.\nOnly earnest actions in a dire crisis\ntruly resonate with people's trust.

original: のっぴきならない状況……。\nすごくピンチな時って事、ですか？
traducao: A dire crisis......?\nDo you mean, an extreme pinch?

original: 他に何がある？\nいざという時程、人の本音というのは\nよく見えるものだ。　望まずとも、な
traducao: What else? In times of crisis, a person's\ntrue nature becomes painfully clear.\nEven if you'd rather not see it.

original: 本音、かぁ……。\n確かに、中途半端な決心じゃ\nいざっていう時に動けないよね……
traducao: True nature, huh......\nIt's true, half-baked resolve won't\nlet you move when it truly counts......

original: フン、ガキが頭を付き合わせて\n何を相談してるかと思えば。\nガキはガキらしい事を考えていればいい
traducao: Hmph. I wondered what you brats were\nhuddled together talking about.\nKids should stick to childish matters.

original: ……そうなのかもしれません
traducao: ......Perhaps you are right.

original: でも……僕、よく考えてみます。\nありがとう、リカルドさん
traducao: Still... I will think hard on this.\nThank you, Mr. Ricardo.

original: キャスタニエ！\n買い出しを手伝ってくれないか？
traducao: Castagnier!\nWould you help me with the shopping?

original: キャスタニエ！\n……いないのか！？
traducao: Castagnier!\n...Are you not in here?!

original: あ〜〜うるっせえ！
traducao: Aaargh, shut the hell up!

original: おい、何の用だ！？
traducao: Hey, what do you want?!

original: な、何だ。\nいるんじゃないか
traducao: Wh-What?\nSo you are here after all.

original: 今日は買い出し担当の日だろう？\n迎えに……
traducao: Aren't you on shopping duty today?\nI came to get you, and...

original: はっ。\nそんなもんは知らねぇ
traducao: Hah.\nLike I give a damn.

original: 俺は、マルタ以外はどうでもいいんだよ。\nわかったら、他を当たるんだな
traducao: I don't care about anyone except Marta.\nGet it? Then go find someone else!

original: キャ……キャスタニエ？
traducao: Cas... Castagnier?

original: ……何だったんだ？　\n今のは……
traducao: ...What was that?\nJust now......

original: よぉ、エミ……
traducao: Yo, Emi--

original: 痛って……
traducao: Owch......

original: ってオイ、\n詫びの言葉もねえのかよッ！？
traducao: Hey!\nYou don't even have an apology?!

original: お前がそこにいるのが悪ぃんだろうが。\n邪魔だ。\nどけ
traducao: It's your fault for being there.\nYou're in the way.\nMove.

original: な……何だと！？\nてめぇ、自分が何言ってるか……
traducao: Wh... What did you say?!\nYou bastard, do you know what you're...

original: ごちゃごちゃうるせぇな！\nどけっつってんだろうが！！
traducao: Quit your damn babbling!\nI told you to get out of my way!!

original: ったたた……何なんだよ、エミルの奴！？
traducao: Ow-ow-ow... What's with that Emil guy?!
